svg.text: Road and track pairings for the fork (z15): same tracks, nine road signals
Primary: paved | Unpaved | Off-road. White road Unpaved. Tracks solid (brown Unpaved, dark brown Off-road), single track dashed, hiking path dots.

foreignObject.div: roads: class tint + dot grain (denser = Off-road). Needs textures: official OsmAnd style only
roads: class fill + thin solid brown line, the track colour inside the road. Plugin OK
roads: tinted fill, casing in the track colour. Plugin OK; weak on orange and red
roads: dashed outline in the track colour. Plugin OK; dashes on roads only
roads: article style 3, dashes in a 60% band. Plugin OK; busiest
roads: article style 5, dashes across the whole road (as Americana). Plugin OK

svg.text: 7. Dashed fill, full width, track colour

foreignObject.div: roads: as 6, blocks in the track brown (dark brown Off-road). Plugin OK
roads: as 5, band in the track brown, class colour kept along both edges. Plugin OK
roads: a continuous brown band inside the class fill, class colour along both edges; no dashes. Plugin OK
